LYTV.notes: Tivat (LYTV), Montenegro, EUR. FCG OPS quote 128936 (14 Nov 2026, valid to 29 Nov 2026; invoiced at this price; A6-AFA GL6T 45,132 kg billed 46 t, GLEX group; OMDW–LYTV–LIML, 15 Nov 2026 10:45Z / 11:30Z, 0 arr. + 1 dep. pax): landing 9.50 per ton 437.00, parking first 4 h free (per ton per day rate not stated) 0.00, departing pax: infrastructure 1.00, security 3.25, PRM 0.25, pax tax 15.00; infrastructure fee 90.00; basic ground handling 670.00; FCG disbursement 11% 133.82 (on airport fees + handling = 1,216.50); supervision on the apron 560.00; landing permit (Montenegro 24H) 40.00; communication 40.00; bank charges credit card 3.5% 69.66 (on everything incl. disbursement = 1,990.32); total 2,059.98. USER DECISIONS (16 Nov 2026): single handler FCG OPS (ops system: FCG OPS TIVAT HANDLING, supervising agent); handling and supervision only in GLEX (group-dependent); landing 9.50 per ton in all groups (22 / 24.5 / 34 / 42 / 46 / 53 t); departing pax charges merged into one row 19.50 per pax; infrastructure fee 90, landing permit 40 and communication 40 in all groups; parking rate empty until stated; disbursement 11% on airport fees and handling (not on supervision, permit, communication); credit card 3.5% as tick row (default off); no night / weekend surcharge stated. EURO JET INTERCONTINENTAL quotations LYTV (undated, received 16 Nov 2026; EUR; general aviation; CL60 22 t, E35L 25 t, GLF4 34 t, GLEX 46 t, GL7T 53 t; no GL5T quote): mandatory services landing 165 / 237.50 / 323 / 437 / 503.50 (landing fee discount 50% for tech stop, not entered), parking per aircraft per day first 4 h free 88 / 100 / 136 / 184 / 212 (4 per ton), passenger fee 15 + passenger security 3.25 + PRM 0.25 + CAA passenger 0.98 + infrastructure 1.00 per departing pax, airport tax 10 per flight, infrastructure fee ramp 40 / 60 / 60 / 90 / 90, ramp handling 320 / 480 / 480 / 670 / 670, technical handling 65 / 135 / 135 / 135 / 135; Euro Jet ground support services 330, Euro Jet admin fee 8% (on landing, airport tax, infrastructure ramp, ramp handling and technical handling; verified against all five estimated totals), communication 60; estimated totals 1,038 / 1,386.30 / 1,478.64 / 1,839.36 / 1,911.18. Additional services: permit arrangements 65 per permit, hotel booking 10 per room (not entered), GPU 50 per 30 min, ASU 100 per operation, passenger stairs 30 towable / 60 self-propelled per 30 min (not entered), lavatory 55 per 30 min, water 30 per 30 min, pushback 70 per operation, business lounge 8 per departing pax (max 20), crew ramp transport 15 and passenger ramp transport 30 per ride (VIP vehicle), crew transportation to / from Tivat 40 / Kotor 50 / Budva 70, passenger hotel transport Tivat 80 / Kotor 100 / H. Novi 220 (not entered). USER DECISIONS (16 Nov 2026): handler EURO JET (FBO, from ops system); ramp handling and technical handling in one Handling Fee cell (no separate technical row); no GL5T prices (quote to be requested); tech stop landing discount not entered; GPU, lavatory, water and pushback per hour in basket; ASU, business lounge, crew and pax ramp transport and crew transportation as tick rows; stairs, hotel booking and hotel transport not entered; disbursement 8% on airport fees and handling; not verified (quote). FLYSTAR (Pearl Executive Aviation DOO) pro-forma invoice 00506/2026 (16 Nov 2026; EUR, VAT 0%; CL60 22 t, E35L 25 t, GLF4 34 t, GLEX 46 t, GL7T 53 t; 1 departing pax; no GL5T quote; each of the five documents reconciles to its total): landing 7.50 per ton for 22 t, 9.50 per ton for the others (165 / 237.50 / 323 / 437 / 503.50), parking 4 per ton (88 / 100 / 136 / 184 / 212; duration and free hours not stated), CIR-technical handling 40 / 60 / 60 / 90 / 90 (entered as Infrastructure Fee), handling 420 / 580 / 580 / 820 / 820, supervision 200 / 300 / 300 / 300 / 300, passenger tax 15 + security 3.25 + PRM 0.25 + ACV 0.98 = 19.48 per departing pax, communal tax 15 per flight (entered as Airport Tax), GPU 50 (1 hour, as requested in our mail), pushback 70, toilet service 55 and lavatory service 30 (per use). Disbursement 10% on landing, parking, CIR-technical handling, passenger charges, communal tax and ACV (not on handling, supervision, GPU, pushback, toilet, lavatory): matches 22 / 25 / 34 t to the cent, panel is 0.03 above at 53 t and 1.87 above at 46 t (the 46 t document shows a lower disbursement). Not in the documents: communication, landing permit, credit card, night / weekend surcharge. USER DECISIONS (17 Nov 2026): handler FLYSTAR (FBO, from ops system); parking entered per started 24 h with no free hours (to be confirmed with Flystar); GPU 50 is the 1-hour price (as requested in our mail); toilet service (as Lavatory Service) and lavatory service (as Potable Water) are per use, entered on the existing rows; no GL5T prices; not verified (pro-forma quote). TIVAT GROUND HANDLING added as a fourth handler on 19 Nov 2026 from an e-mail quotation of 18 Nov 2026 (Ivana Krivokapic, apm.co.me), forwarded to us. Charges as quoted, by aircraft type: CIR 40 / 60 / 60 / 90 / 90, RHC ramp handling 320 / 480 / 480 / 670 / 670, landing 165 / 237.50 / 323 / 437 / 503.50, parking 88 / 100 / 136 / 184 / 212, communal tax 10 per flight; pushback 70 per movement, GPU 50 per 30 minutes, lavatory service 55, potable water not applicable. Group mapping: 22,000 kg to CL60, 24,300 kg to E35L, 33,838 kg to GLF4, 52,095 kg to GL7T, and the second line labelled GL7T at 45,452 kg to GL5T by user decision of 19 Nov 2026. This handler gives no price for the GLEX group, which is therefore left empty. The quotation prices on the next whole tonne, landing 9.50 per ton (7.50 at 22 t) and parking 4 per ton, so 45,452 kg is charged as 46 t: 46 x 9.50 = 437 and 46 x 4 = 184; every other line matches its tonnage the same way, which confirms the reading. RHC is entered in the Handling Fee row, CIR in Infrastructure Fee and the communal tax in Airport Tax, as at Flystar. Parking states no duration and no free hours, so it is entered per started 24 h with no free hours, on the safe side. GPU 50 per 30 minutes is doubled to 100 for the panel's per-hour row. Lavatory 55 is entered as quoted: by the user's rule of 19 Nov 2026 the lavatory row is always a per-service price and carries no time unit. Potable water is left as a dash. Not in the quotation and left empty by user decision: supervision, communication, landing permit, credit card, the departing passenger charges, disbursement and any night or weekend surcharge. The CIR, RHC, landing, parking and communal tax figures match the corresponding Euro Jet rows in this panel to the cent, so this is the same underlying airport and ramp handling price Euro Jet passes through, without Euro Jet's ground support services 330, communication 60 and 8 per cent admin fee. No type is recorded for this handler: it has not been seen in the ops system. Not verified (quotation).
